_meta.jsRuntimeLeg: none — backend/fleet is Go-only server logic with no TypeScript mirror; this table is asserted only across the Go build-target matrix
_meta.purpose: openspec change migrate-fleet-to-continuous-burns, tasks.md 4.11 — pins the commanded-acceleration validation's rejection DECISION for NaN/+Inf/-Inf/zero/negative inputs cross-target, deliberately WITHOUT recording any value derived from the unguarded expression those inputs would otherwise reach (space.QuantizeArrival's `int64(math.Ceil(flightSeconds*1000))`, which is `int64(math.Ceil(NaN*1000))` when accel is NaN — 0 on arm64, -9223372036854775808 on amd64; this is the exact class pin-system-generation-determinism was created to eliminate for backend/system's keplerPeriodMs). The recorded field here is `wantErr`, a Go sentinel-error identity name — a value that is, by construction, the SAME string on every architecture, because a correct implementation must reject these inputs BEFORE they ever reach the divergent conversion. Recording a value here is therefore safe in a way recording keplerPeriodMs's NaN case was not: this family pins the guard's decision, never the guarded-against arithmetic's result.
_meta.crossTargetSafety: every 'wantErr' value below is a Go identifier name (fleet.ErrAccelBelowFloor), never a numeric result of evaluating the commanded acceleration — see 'purpose' above for why that distinction is what makes cross-target pinning valid here.

commandedAccelRejection.name: below the disclosure floor but finite and positive

_fuelCostAndRefundMeta.purpose: openspec change add-fuel-as-cargo, tasks.md 2.7 — golden cases for the burn fuel-cost conversion (fleet-movement 'A Burn's Fuel Cost Scales With Roster Hull Count, Never Loaded Mass') and the closed-form discard refund ('Discarding a Running Burn Refunds Its Unspent Fuel, Closed-Form'). A new family alongside commandedAccelRejection in this same file (tasks.md 2.7 names 'a new fixtures/fleet/ (or equivalent) family' — this IS that family, additive to the pre-existing key above, not a replacement).
_fuelCostAndRefundMeta.costFormula: costTons = (accel * flightSeconds) * hullCount / deltaVPerTon, where flightSeconds = (arriveMs - departMs) / 1000 and deltaVPerTon = FuelParams.DeltaVPerTon (5.0, the placeholder value fleet-movement's own requirement text pins).
_fuelCostAndRefundMeta.refundFormula: refundTons = storedDebitedCostTons * (flightDurationMs - tauMs) / flightDurationMs, where flightDurationMs = arriveMs - departMs (the burn's own stored window) and tauMs = the discard instant minus departMs — task 2.6's stored debited-cost-in-tons field is the refund's only input besides the timing, never a re-derivation from hull count/roster at discard time.
_fuelCostAndRefundMeta.crossTargetSafety: every value below is exact rational arithmetic on round inputs (no sqrt, no float64 accumulation edge) — chosen deliberately so this table needs no per-architecture variant, unlike commandedAccelRejection's NaN-propagation cases above.

fuelCost.name: single hull, ceiling-ish accel, round flight time
ten hulls, identical burn — cost scales linearly with hull count, never with loaded mass

discardRefund.name: cut near-zero elapsed — refunds nearly the full stored cost
cut near-full elapsed — refunds almost nothing
